query:
-- Summary counts by state and status for House races
SELECT state_code, status, COUNT(*) as count
FROM house_races
WHERE state_code IN ('GA','KY','OR','PA','WV','NE','ID')
GROUP BY state_code, status
ORDER BY state_code, status;
